protocol_overview.type: Host-mastered command/address/data protocol over an 8-bit DQ bus with cycle-type selection via CLE (command), ALE (address), or neither (data) — latched on WE_n rising edge (SDR) or CLK rising edge (NV-DDR) or both DQS edges (NV-DDR data). Multi-LUN / multi-plane parallelism on top of a per-LUN status register and a per-target open-drain Ready/Busy line.
protocol_overview.duplex: half-duplex (DQ bus shared for command, address, write data, and read data; W/R_n on NV-DDR specifies bus owner; bus turns around via tWB / tRR timing on SDR)
protocol_overview.asynchronous_mode: SDR (WE_n latches commands/addresses/writes; RE_n strobes reads)
wire_names_nv_ddr_extra: W/R_n (shares pin with RE_n; selects DQ bus owner)
wire_names_nv_ddr2_3_extra: ZQ (calibration reference; tied to Vss via RZQ)
protocol_overview.host_role: Bus master; drives CE_n / CLE / ALE / WE_n (or CLK) / RE_n (or W/R_n) / WP_n / DQ during write cycles; reads R/B_n and DQ during read cycles; runs initialization, training, and feature programming.
protocol_overview.device_role: Slave; latches command/address/write data on CLE/ALE/WE_n; drives DQ on RE_n falling edge (SDR) or DQS edges (NV-DDR family) during read cycles; drives R/B_n LOW while any LUN operation is in progress.

functional_requirements.text: The device shall expose, at minimum, CE_n, CLE, ALE, WE_n, RE_n, WP_n, R/B_n, DQ[7:0], Vcc, VccQ, Vss, VssQ. NV-DDR family additionally requires CLK (shared with WE_n), W/R_n (shared with RE_n), DQS, and for NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 differential DQS_t/DQS_c plus VREFQ and ZQ.

The device shall support at least the asynchronous SDR data interface. Optional support for NV-DDR (up to 400 MT/s), NV-DDR2 (up to 800 MT/s), NV-DDR3 (up to 1200 MT/s) shall be advertised via the Parameter Page.

Bus cycle type shall be selected by CLE/ALE: CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n pulse → command cycle (DQ = opcode). CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n pulse → address cycle (DQ = address byte). CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n pulse → write-data cycle. CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n pulse → read-data cycle.

The device shall implement the mandatory command set: Read (00h/30h), Block Erase (60h/D0h), Read Status (70h), Page Program (80h/10h), Read ID (90h), Read Parameter Page (ECh), Reset (FFh), Change Read Column (05h/E0h), Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h, NV-DDR3 only), Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h, NV-DDR3 only).

R/B_n shall be an open-drain output requiring an external pull-up. R/B_n shall be LOW whenever ANY LUN on the target has an array operation in progress. R/B_n shall be HIGH only when ALL LUNs on the target are ready.

Read Status (70h) shall return one status byte; bit 7 = WP_n, bit 6 = RDY (ready), bit 5 = ARDY (array ready), bit 4 = VSP (vendor specific), bit 3 = CSP (command-specific), bit 2 = Reserved (0), bit 1 = FAILC (prior cached command failed), bit 0 = FAIL (last command failed).

The device shall provide a 256-byte Parameter Page accessible via Read Parameter Page (ECh, 00h address). Bytes 0-3 shall be the signature 'ONFI' (4Fh, 4Eh, 46h, 49h). Bytes 254-255 shall be the Integrity CRC (polynomial 8005h, initial 4F4Eh). At least three redundant copies of the Parameter Page shall be stored (bytes 0-255, 256-511, 512-767).
Read Unique ID (EDh) shall return a 16-byte UID followed by its 16-byte bit-wise complement, repeated 16 times. The UID is valid if (UID XOR complement) is all ones.

Each LUN within a target shall execute commands and report status independently. While R/B_n is LOW, Read Status Enhanced (78h) with row-address-selected LUN/plane shall be used to poll a specific LUN.
Multi-plane operations shall use the 11h or D1h second command between plane operations (Multi-plane Page Program 80h/11h, Multi-plane Block Erase 60h/D1h).
WP_n shall disable Program and Erase operations when LOW. WP_n shall NOT disable Read operations.

Reset (FFh) shall return the device to the asynchronous SDR data interface in timing mode 0, with all volatile state cleared. Synchronous Reset (FCh) shall reset the LUN without changing the data interface or timing mode. Reset LUN (FAh) shall reset only the addressed LUN.

Set Features (EFh) and Get Features (EEh) with a 1-byte feature address followed by 4 bytes of parameter data shall configure / query Timing Mode (FAh), NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 Configuration (02h), I/O Drive Strength (10h), DCC / Read DQ Training / Write TX DQ Training (08h..0Bh), External Vpp (39h), Volume Configuration (58h), EZ NAND control (80h..81h).

Devices supporting NV-DDR2 or NV-DDR3 shall support ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) after reset (typical tZQCL ≥ 1 µs) and ZQ Calibration Short (D9h) for periodic V/T drift correction. ZQ pin shall be tied to Vss through an external RZQ reference resistor.

Devices supporting matrix termination shall support ODT Configure (E2h). Each LUN may be in Deselected, Selected, or Sniff ODT state. ODT shall be enabled/disabled at the tDQSCK boundary per Section 4.16.

Devices supporting CE_n pin reduction shall support Volume Select (E1h) and provide ENi/ENo enumeration pins. Volume Address (max 4 bits) shall be appointed during initialization and used to direct subsequent commands to the correct target sharing the common CE_n.

Parameter Page Integrity CRC (bytes 254-255) shall be 16-bit CRC with generator 8005h, initial 4F4Eh, no final XOR, no bit reversal, computed over bytes 0-253. Host shall validate the CRC and fall back to redundant copies on mismatch.

If the 256-byte Parameter Page cannot describe all device capabilities, an Extended Parameter Page (signature 'EPPS' = 45h, 50h, 50h, 53h at bytes 2-5) shall be stored after the redundant Parameter Pages and shall contain section-typed records (section type 2 = Extended ECC Information).

EZ NAND devices shall report EZ NAND support in the Parameter Page. Status register bit 0 (FAIL) shall be valid for Read, Program, and Erase operations on EZ NAND (vs. Program/Erase only on raw NAND).
WP_n shall not transition from HIGH to LOW or LOW to HIGH while the Write Enable signal is active or during a Program / Erase operation.

configurations.name: SDR x8
configurations.description: Asynchronous SDR data interface, 8-bit DQ. Command / address / write data latched on rising edge of WE_n. Read data emitted on falling edge of RE_n. Supports up to 200 MT/s in highest timing mode.

configurations.name: SDR x16
configurations.description: Asynchronous SDR data interface, 16-bit DQ (DQ[15:0]). Only available on SDR-only packages (TSOP-48, LGA-52, BGA-63).

configurations.name: NV-DDR
configurations.description: Source-synchronous, single-data-strobe DQS, CLK on the WE_n pin. Command/address latched on rising CLK; data latched on both DQS edges. Up to 400 MT/s.

configurations.name: NV-DDR2
configurations.description: Source-synchronous with differential DQS_t/DQS_c. WE_n latches command/address on rising edge. Data on both DQS edges. ODT + ZQ Calibration. Up to 800 MT/s.

configurations.name: NV-DDR3
configurations.description: Source-synchronous with differential DQS_t/DQS_c AND differential RE_t/RE_c. Adds DCC / Read DQ Training / Write TX DQ Training / Write RX DQ Training. Up to 1200 MT/s.

configurations.name: EZ NAND
configurations.description: NAND with controller die stacked in package; ECC and lithography-specific management offloaded; reduced command-set changes. Status bit 0 valid for Read in addition to Program/Erase.

configurations.name: CE_n pin reduction
configurations.description: Multiple targets share one CE_n; per-target Volume Address enumerated via ENi/ENo daisy chain at boot. Volume Select (E1h) directs commands.

error_response_conditions: Read failure on EZ NAND — Status bit 0 (FAIL) set in Read Status; CSP (bit 3) optionally indicates ECC threshold exceeded (rewrite recommended).
Program failure — Status bit 0 (FAIL) set; addressed page is in indeterminate state.
Erase failure / attempt to erase factory-marked bad block — Status bit 0 (FAIL) set; device does not proceed.
Program Cache prior-command failure — Status bit 1 (FAILC) set after second 15h or 10h transferred.
Parameter Page CRC mismatch — host shall read the next redundant copy (bytes 256-511, 512-767, additional copies).
Read Unique ID complement mismatch — host shall read the next of the 16 UID/complement copies.
Write Protect violation (WP_n LOW during Program/Erase) — device shall not perform the operation; FAIL bit is implementation-defined.
ZQ Calibration failure — Status bit 0 (FAIL) set in devices supporting ZQ calibration.
Invalid timing mode programmed via Set Features — device may enter an indeterminate state; host shall issue Reset (FFh) to recover.
compliance_requirements: Host shall hold WP_n stable during Program and Erase operations.
Host shall hold DQS_t HIGH during NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 Idle states (ALE=CLE=CE_n=0) when ODT is enabled, otherwise the device may incorrectly enable ODT.
Host shall not retry Read after a FAIL on EZ NAND without first checking the Status register via Read Status Enhanced.
Host shall wait for R/B_n HIGH (or RDY=1 in status) before issuing a new command to the same LUN, except for Read Status (70h), Read Status Enhanced (78h), and Reset (FFh/FCh/FAh).
Host shall enforce tWB / tRR / tCS / tCH / tCEA / tCLR / tWHR / tCCS timing per Section 4.17 for the active data interface.
Host shall validate Parameter Page Integrity CRC before trusting any reported field value.
Host shall not issue Read Status Enhanced during or immediately after a Target-level command (e.g., Read Parameter Page, Read ID, ZQ Calibration); host shall use Read Status (70h) in those sequences.
Host shall issue ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) once after Reset and periodically per device parameter-page-reported tZQCS_interval.
Host shall ensure WP_n does not transition during Program / Erase or while Write Enable is active.
Host shall not configure a timing mode that exceeds the device-reported maximum (Parameter Page bytes 129-130 / 142-143 / 160-161).
